name: rank_persist
notes: First run with role-free derived observation features (user OK 2026-11-21): obs 'rank' = the 46-number team observation + 10 ranks (me and my 4 teammates nearest first: rank in our team by distance to the ball and by depth). Start = kickstart_persist u400 with zero weights on the 10 new inputs (rl/pad_inputs.py: plays identically at u0). Everything else is persist_long2 (same recipe, seed, 600 updates), so the only difference vs the control is the observation. Trained on the MacBook Air (M4, fanless), background QoS. Expectation: if sorting players is what the 128-wide net cannot do, h2h vs RL4/RL5 should rise above the 0.76-1.09 band.
